items.label: Jiangfeng Electronic Materials annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-16-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Plans and outlook (annual report, company guidance): through its private placement

set.signal: Plans and outlook (annual report, company guidance): through its private placement the company plans to build a semiconductor sputtering target production base in Korea, industrialise electrostatic chucks as a key part, and upgrade its R&D and testing center and regional service centers. The company says the precision-parts business is still at an early stage and that, as key parts are developed further and capacity is gradually released, its profitability will keep improving; it plans a sales, service and technical-support network covering Southeast Asia and Europe.

items.reason: Skill 2: financing terms/process are not captured - drop the private-placement review-approval date (March 18, 2026); the capacity plan the placement funds stays.

items.label: Kehua Data half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
items.signal_prefix: H1 2026 detail (half-year report): net profit excluding non-recurring

set.signal: H1 2026 detail (half-year report): net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 242,354,143.05, up 8.37% (net profit attributable up 62.69%); non-recurring gains totalled RMB 153,852,376.35, including RMB 201,904,779.14 from disposals of non-current assets. Investment income was RMB 189,688,253.51 (41.22% of total profit), mainly from disposing of subsidiary equity: the sale of Guangdong Keyun Chenhang Computing Technology on May 28, 2026 produced an investment gain of RMB 1.85 hundred million (32.69% of net profit). Operating cash flow RMB 625,979,433.54 versus RMB -12,464,220.15 a year earlier. Within the data-center business, data-center products RMB 904,390,465.40 (up 15.32%, gross margin 31.10%, down 4.96 points) and IDC services RMB 686,309,127.69 (up 11.89%, gross margin 12.50%, down 8.27 points); data-center business gross margin down 6.28 points. Domestic revenue RMB 3,030,956,956.65, down 10.06%.

items.reason: The entry called the RMB 189.69M investment income the main part of the RMB 153.85M non-recurring total (a pre-tax figure larger than the total). The report gives the non-recurring total with its largest item (disposal gains RMB 201.90M) and separately says investment income came mainly from the subsidiary-equity disposal. The fix states each figure as printed.
